name: inherited_text_program
source:
note text bytes with every escape are written to stdout and read back with get and len
text t "a\tb\\c\"d\ne"
global g uchar 16
fn main to int
n = write int 1 t ulong 0 len t
put g 0 get t 2
ret add int get t 0 int add len t ulong get g 0
end
